meta.title: Khalil Alblushi — Software Engineer, Muscat
meta.description: I design, build and launch complete websites and web apps, from the first sketch to the server it runs on.

hero.intro: I'm Khalil, a software engineer in Muscat. I design, build and launch complete websites and web apps — from the first sketch to the server it runs on.
hero.whatsappMessage: Hi Khalil, I have a project idea I'd like to talk about.

world.caption: The real sun and moon over Muscat, drawn live on your phone. No video, no photos.

demo.label: Live example: an online ordering page

process.intro: You always know where your project is, what comes next, and what it costs. Here's Dar Karak again, from the first message to the first real order.

steps.title: We talk it through
steps.body: Tell me about your business in your own words: on WhatsApp, on a call, or over karak. I ask the questions that matter, then send you a short, clear plan with a quote for your project.
steps.deliverable: A clear plan with a quote for your project

steps.title: You see it before it's built
steps.body: I design every screen first. You try it on your own phone, ask for changes, and approve it. Nothing gets built until you love how it looks.
steps.deliverable: A clickable design of every screen
steps.yourPart: Try it and tell me what to change

steps.title: I build it properly
steps.body: Fast, secure, and in Arabic and English from day one. You get a private link to follow real progress as it's built, not just promises.
steps.deliverable: A private link to follow progress

steps.title: It goes live, and I stay
steps.body: I set up the domain, the hosting, and everything in between. Your customers start using it, and I'm still here for fixes, questions, and your next idea.
steps.deliverable: A live website, plus support after launch

messages.text: Salam Khalil! I want customers to order karak from their phones.
Love it. Pickup from the shop, or delivery too?
Pickup for now. And it has to be Arabic and English.

planItems: Every order reaches the shop instantly

work.intro: A café's ordering site in Muscat and a platform for a government entity. Very different clients, the same care.

matcha.name: Matcha Muse
matcha.summary: A matcha café wanted customers to order from their phones without downloading an app. I designed, built and launched the whole site, in Arabic and English.
points: Arabic and English, each designed on its own, not just translated
Pick a flavour, choose the milk, review the bag
Orders arrive on the shop's WhatsApp, ready to confirm
matcha.shotLabel: The Matcha Muse website on a laptop and a phone

gov.name: One platform, many departments
gov.summary: I work on a platform used by several departments of a government entity. Each department has its own space and its own data, and everything runs on the entity's own servers, with no internet connection.
points: Many departments share one platform, with their data kept apart
Runs fully offline on internal servers
Staff sign in with the accounts they already have
gov.note: This work is private, so it's shown as a diagram instead of screenshots.

next.title: Your project could be next.
next.body: More case studies are on the way. In the meantime, tell me what you're building.

contact.intro: Tell me about it on WhatsApp or by email, in Arabic or English. No technical words needed.
contact.whatsappBody: The quickest way to reach me.
